description: A circuit hosts multiple races and a race cannot exist without a circuit venue.
A season is composed of races; each race belongs to exactly one championship year.
Race results are part of a race; a result cannot exist without its race.
Lap time records are part of a race and carry its race identifier.
Qualifying results belong to a race weekend and reference the race.
Driver standings are recorded after each race and are part of the race sequence.
Constructor race results are part of a race and cannot exist independently.
A race result is attributed to a driver who participates independently of that race.
A race result is attributed to the constructor the driver raced for.
A qualifying result is attributed to a driver.
A qualifying result is attributed to the constructor the driver raced for.
A lap record is attributed to the driver who drove the lap.
A driver standing row belongs to one driver.
A constructor race result belongs to one constructor.
A result carries a status label explaining its classification or retirement reason.

connection_condition: forename fld017 and surname fld018 are concatenated; fld016 is the separate short code
description: A driver's full name is derived from the forename and surname fields.

connection_condition: age ordering derives from birth date fld019; youngest is the maximum birth date
description: Driver age and youngest/oldest ordering are derived from the birth date.

connection_condition: ratio of results with non-null time fld024 to all results in scope
description: Race completion rate is derived from the count of results with a non-null race time relative to all results in scope.

connection_condition: minimum lap milliseconds fld034 per driver per race; a precomputed value is also stored in tab13.fld048
description: Fastest lap time is derived as the minimum lap duration for a driver in a race.

connection_condition: mean lap milliseconds per driver per race
description: Average lap time is derived by averaging lap durations for a driver in a race.

connection_condition: count of first-place race results; cumulative wins are also stored in tab08.fld031
description: Driver wins can be derived by counting race results with finishing position 1.

connection_condition: ratio of a counted race subset to the counted total, multiplied by 100
description: Percentage share is derived from counted subsets of races or results relative to their corresponding total.

connection_condition: tab05.fld020 and tab04.fld020 share the same 68-value year domain from 1950 to 2017
description: Race year and season year express the same championship year concept in different tables.
A race winner is a race result whose finishing position is 1; the winner value domain is a subset of race results.
A season champion is the driver standing with position 1 at the final race of the season.
